fields.Name: T138 - Communication New Message
fields.Description: Verifies the Communication app's New Message section renders the message composition form with its Channel, From, Subject, and Body inputs, without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app. Its default section is 'New Message' (the left nav also lists Monitor, Logs, Providers, Templates, Runs). Confirm the New Message composition form renders, showing message-composition inputs — specifically a Channel selector, a From field, a Subject field, and a Body field. Do not actually send a message. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Communication app is open with the New Message section selected
The message composition form renders, showing composition inputs such as Channel, From, Subject, and Body
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
